name: Kronos
description: Kronos: A Foundation Model for the Language of Financial Markets
one_liner: An AI model trained to read price-chart patterns (like a human chartist) and forecast what a stock or crypto price might do next.
buyer: A crypto trading bot developer or small quant researcher who wants a pattern-forecasting signal to feed into a trading strategy, not a retail investor looking for guaranteed returns.
business_use_cases: A crypto trading bot developer adds Kronos's forecasts as one signal among several in an existing algorithmic strategy.
A fintech app offers a 'market pattern insight' widget to retail users, clearly labeled as a probabilistic model output, not financial advice.
A quant researcher uses it to backtest forecasting ideas faster than building a foundation model from scratch.

money_ideas.idea: Sell API access to Kronos-based forecasts to other trading-bot developers, billed per call.
A subscription 'daily market signal' newsletter for retail crypto traders, generated from the model's output.

steal_this: Build a small backtesting dashboard that runs Kronos against a handful of liquid crypto pairs and reports its historical hit rate honestly — a credibility tool before selling any signal product.
